name: Toyeeb A. Abd’Azeez
intro: I build data-driven solutions using Python, machine learning, and modern deployment tools, with a focus on turning data into practical and deployable applications.
summary: I use Python for data analysis and machine learning, with hands-on practice in data cleaning, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and tuning. I build end-to-end applications and have experience deploying through APIs and cloud platforms. I’m interested in Data Science, Machine Learning, and practical AI applications.
about: I am committed to developing my skills in Data Science and Machine Learning through continous learning and hands-on projects. I enjoy working through the full process—from understanding and preparing data to building useful, deployable machine learning solutions.

projects.title: AI Receipt Scanner
projects.idea: An AI-powered document and receipt processing application that extracts structured transaction information from receipt images using a vision-language model.
projects.approach: Receipt images are processed with a vision-language model, and extracted transaction details are stored as structured records in a PostgreSQL database.
projects.result: A deployed application that processes receipt images, extracts transaction information, and stores structured records in PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Flight Price Prediction API
projects.idea: A machine learning system that predicts flight prices from flight-related features and exposes the trained model through a REST API.
projects.approach: Flight data and features are prepared for model development; the resulting prediction model is exposed through a REST API.
projects.result: A deployed prediction API that accepts flight information and returns a predicted flight price. The API is built with FastAPI, and was implemented with Exchangerate API. The resulting app predicts flight prices, and convert from INR to NGN.

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.idea: A machine learning classification project for identifying potentially fraudulent transactions from transaction data.
projects.approach: Transaction data is prepared with feature engineering, then classification models are developed and evaluated with appropriate classification metrics. No performance figures are included because none were provided.
projects.result: A trained classification model designed to distinguish potentially fraudulent transactions from legitimate ones.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.idea: A machine learning classification system that predicts customers who are likely to churn.
projects.approach: Customer data is prepared for classification, with several model approaches used to develop churn predictions. The prediction is presented through an interactive application.
projects.result: A machine learning application that predicts customer churn and presents the prediction through an interactive interface.
